skill.name: quality-documentation-manager
skill.description: Guides quality documentation control for regulated medical device teams. It covers document control, regulatory document review, change control, DMS planning, and documentation compliance.
skill.summary: Plan, review, and improve regulated quality documentation systems.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Regulated teams need consistent document control across approvals, revisions, training, and submissions. This skill provides structured guidance for compliant documentation systems and regulatory document review.
actual_capabilities: Defines document control system structures for regulated quality teams.
Outlines regulatory documentation review for FDA, EU MDR, ISO, and international markets.
Maps change control workflows with impact assessment, approval, implementation, and closure steps.
Guides DMS planning, configuration, validation, deployment, and performance monitoring.
Identifies quality metrics for document accuracy, compliance, efficiency, training, and system performance.
Connects documentation work with QMS, CAPA, training, audit, and regulatory affairs processes.
limitations: It provides guidance and review structure, not legal or regulatory approval.
It depends on the user to supply current procedures, records, and jurisdictional requirements.
The included helper files are placeholders and do not automate a real document management system.
It cannot validate a live DMS or inspect restricted records without user-provided evidence.

use_cases.title: Build a Document Control Framework
use_cases.description: Create document classes, ownership rules, approval flows, revision controls, retention rules, and archive practices for a regulated QMS.

use_cases.title: Review Regulatory Documentation
use_cases.description: Check submission documents for completeness, traceability, version control, approval evidence, and alignment with target market expectations.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Change and Training Controls
use_cases.description: Plan document changes with impact assessment, reviewer routing, training triggers, implementation evidence, and closure verification.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Document Control Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new or improving QMS.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a document control plan for a medical device QMS. Include document types, owners, review steps, approval rules, and retention controls.

prompt_templates.title: Review Regulatory Documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before audit or submission work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this regulatory document set for completeness. Check traceability, version control, approval evidence, and gaps against ISO 13485 and submission needs.

prompt_templates.title: Design Change Control Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced process design for controlled document changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a change control workflow for controlled documents. Include impact assessment, reviewer roles, training triggers, validation evidence, and closure criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Validated DMS Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced implementation planning for electronic document management.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a DMS implementation plan for a regulated organization. Include requirements, migration controls, Part 11 controls, validation, training, and performance metrics.

output_examples.input: Review our SOP change process for document control gaps.
output_examples.output: The review highlights missing approval roles, unclear effective date rules, and absent training impact assessment. It recommends adding owner, approver, revision history, and closure checks.

output_examples.input: Create a DMS rollout checklist for a medical device company.
output_examples.output: The checklist covers requirements, access controls, migration readiness, validation testing, training, go-live approval, audit trail review, and post-launch monitoring.

output_examples.input: Assess our regulatory file before an EU MDR technical documentation review.
output_examples.output: The assessment flags traceability, controlled copy status, missing cross-references, outdated approvals, and records that need owner confirmation before review.

best_practices: Provide the current procedure, document list, approval matrix, and target regulations before asking for review.
Ask for clear evidence lists, owners, and closure criteria when planning document changes.
Use the skill to prepare audit questions, then verify answers against controlled records.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated guidance as final regulatory or legal approval.
Do not request a generic template without naming the document type, market, and process owner.
Do not skip human approval for controlled documents because the skill suggested wording.

faq.question: What regulations does this skill reference?
faq.answer: It references ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR, FDA submission documentation, and 21 CFR Part 11 concepts.

faq.question: Can it approve controlled documents?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare review guidance, but authorized personnel must approve controlled documents.

faq.question: Does it include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The repository contains placeholder helper files, so automation requires separate implementation.

faq.question: Can it help with DMS selection?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure requirements, selection criteria, validation needs, access controls, and rollout planning.

faq.question: Is it limited to medical devices?
faq.answer: The content is written for medical device quality systems, but many document control practices apply elsewhere.

faq.question: How should I provide source material?
faq.answer: Provide procedures, document registers, change records, audit findings, and target regulations with confidential data removed.
